name: pages
title: Pages
description: Page kit for `create_page`: publish a report, one-pager, dashboard or deck by filling `kit: { template, slots }`; the server renders layout, charts and styling, and a dashboard can refresh from KV. Free HTML is the escape hatch for interactive pages (design system, minimalist taste rules, browser SDK, rooms, `<swarm-diff>`). Also covers auth modes, share URLs, themes, the org design system, PDF export and limits.
